name: Paterna de Rivera (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of yellow and green alternating, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Paterna de Rivera (a castle on red and green and white bars).
history: Municipal flag of Paterna de Rivera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Paterna de Rivera arms — castle, bars
